# Symaira Vault vault - ignore sensitive files
identity.age
.device-id
*.key
*.pem
# Ignore Symaira Vault runtime artifacts
mcp-token
mcp-tokens.json
.runtime-port
# Ignore OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
# Ignore IDE files
.idea/
.vscode/
*.swp
*.swo
*~

agents:
    adm:
        tier: admin
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        canManageConfig: true
        requireApproval: false
    mgr:
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        canManageConfig: true
        requireApproval: false
    cli:
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        requireApproval: false
vault:
    authMethod: passphrase
    search_index: true
    auto_heal_zero_key: true
git:
    commit_template: Update from Symaira Vault
    auto_push: true
vaultDir: <ROOT:0>/template-vault
defaultAgent: cli
sessionTimeout: 15m0s
sessionMaxLifetime: 8h0m0s
authMethod: passphrase
useTouchID: false

To consume a secret without seeing it:

agents:
    adm:
        tier: admin
        approvalMode: none
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        canManageConfig: true
        canUseClipboard: true
        canUseAutotype: true
        canReadValues: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: true
        requireApproval: false
    claude-code:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.claude/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    cli:
        approvalMode: none
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        requireApproval: false
    codex:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.codex/skills/symvault/AGENTS.md
    default:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: false
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
    hermes:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.hermes/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    mgr:
        approvalMode: none
        allowedPaths:
            - '*'
        canWrite: true
        canManageConfig: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        requireApproval: false
    openclaw:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: true
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.openclaw/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
    opencode:
        approvalMode: deny
        canWrite: false
        canRunCommands: true
        exposeValueTools: true
        autoUnseal: false
        skillPath: ~/.opencode/skills/symvault/SKILL.md
vault:
    authMethod: passphrase
    legacy_mode: false
    search_index: true
    scrypt_work_factor: 18
    auto_heal_zero_key: true
    format_version: 1
git:
    commit_template: Update from Symaira Vault
    auto_push: true
    auto_pull: true
    auto_pull_interval: 10s
mcp: {}
vaultDir: <ROOT:0>/template-vault
defaultAgent: cli
sessionTimeout: 15m0s
sessionMaxLifetime: 8h0m0s
authMethod: passphrase
useTouchID: false
